reason: A browser-local prompt library that organizes reusable prompts and applies selected prompts as system instructions within DeepSeek Harness Web sessions.

summaries.zh: 在浏览器本地管理、搜索和备份可复用提示词，并在 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话中将选定提示词作为系统指令使用。
summaries.en: Manage, search, and back up reusable prompts locally in the browser, then apply selected prompts as system instructions in DeepSeek Harness Web sessions.

capabilities: Create, edit, delete, search, favorite, and sort reusable prompts
Inject selected prompts as system instructions into the current chat session
Persist prompt data and session selections in browser localStorage
Import and export prompt libraries as JSON backups
Provide slash-command and toolbar-based prompt selection in the chat interface
